coded.vl: Dedicated instrument with narrower rights, or only selected articles of the general law
coded.n: Private-sector labor law excludes domestic workers; dedicated Law 68/2015 with Ministerial Decisions 2194/2016 and 22/2022.
coded.src: Law 6/2010 art. 5; Law 68/2015; MD 2194/2016; MD 22/2022; ILO FAIRWAY factsheet (Dec. 2023)

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required, no language rule
coded.n: Contract on the form prescribed by the Domestic Workers Department, in English and Arabic (not necessarily a language the worker understands); renewable annually.

coded.vl: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
coded.n: Minimum wage of KWD 75 a month, the same figure as for the private sector.

coded.vl: At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
coded.n: Monthly, within seven days of the due date, against a receipt; KWD 10 penalty for each month of delay.

coded.vl: Only a daily rest rule, or a longer limit than for other workers
coded.n: Up to 12 hours a day including breaks; the standard contract adds an hour's rest after five hours and 8 consecutive hours of night rest; up to two extra hours paid at half a day's wage.
coded.src: Law 68/2015 art. 22(2); Standard Contract (2020) art. 7(3); MD 22/2022 art. 30

coded.vl: Weekly rest provided but it may be worked for pay or another day, or is shorter
Equal to or longer than for other workers
coded.n: 30 days' paid annual leave after 11 months.

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents
coded.vl: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
coded.n: Confiscation prohibited, but the employer may keep the passport and ID with the worker's consent.

coded.vl: Accommodation standards only; living in may be required
coded.n: Decent food and housing; the worker may own and use a mobile phone and contact family outside working hours.

coded.vl: Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met
coded.n: Transfer with the employer's permission; without it, only in listed cases (employer's death or departure, divorce, ineligibility or imprisonment, proven sexual misconduct). No exit permit is required.

coded.vl: Worker may not be charged recruitment fees
coded.n: Neither the employer nor the recruitment agency may recover recruitment costs from the worker; agencies may not charge "advance wages".

coded.vl: Agencies licensed and liable to the worker (refund, return costs or joint liability)
coded.n: Licensed offices; liability during the probation period.

coded.vl: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
coded.n: Domestic Workers Department investigates and decides within two weeks; unresolved cases go to the Civil Court (Labour Circuit) free of court fees.
coded.src: MD 22/2022 art. 34; CoM Decision 614/2018; ILO factsheet

coded.vl: Partial: medical care, injury cover or employer insurance only
coded.n: Mandatory employer-paid health insurance; injury treatment and compensation in the contract; end-of-service pay of one month per year. No sick or maternity leave in the law.

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
coded.vl: General criminal or civil law only
coded.n: Harmful, dangerous or degrading work prohibited; government shelter for women workers (since 2014).
No provision enabling domestic workers to join a trade union.

dec.n: Qualifications for owners of domestic worker offices
dec.pe: Kuwait’s new domestic workers law set education and health conditions for people who own recruitment offices. The Constitutional Court struck down that clause. The case concerns office owners, not workers, but shapes how recruitment is regulated.
dec.pi: UU pekerja rumah tangga Kuwait yang baru menetapkan syarat pendidikan dan kesehatan bagi pemilik kantor perekrut. MK membatalkan klausul itu. Perkara ini menyangkut pemilik kantor, bukan pekerja, tetapi memengaruhi cara perekrutan diatur.

dec.n: Recruitment offices’ challenge to the Domestic Workers Law
dec.pe: Ten domestic worker recruitment offices said the law was unfair to them because it made them send workers home and repay employers in some cases. The Constitutional Court rejected their challenge.
dec.pi: Sepuluh kantor perekrut pekerja rumah tangga berpendapat UU tidak adil karena mewajibkan mereka memulangkan pekerja dan mengembalikan uang majikan dalam kasus tertentu. MK menolak gugatan mereka.

dec.n: Domestic worker leaving before the end of her contract
dec.pe: An employer in Kuwait took a domestic worker to court for leaving before her two-year contract ended. The court rejected the case. Reports say a worker cannot be forced to stay.
dec.pi: Seorang majikan di Kuwait menggugat pekerja rumah tangga yang berhenti sebelum kontrak dua tahunnya selesai. Pengadilan menolak gugatan itu. Menurut laporan, pekerja tidak bisa dipaksa bertahan.
